title: Interaction between power saving mode and extended idle mode DRX cycle

entities.name: Power Saving Mode
entities.description: Power saving mode that allows UE to conserve battery by remaining in a low-power state for extended periods.

entities.name: Extended idle mode DRX cycle
entities.description: Extended Discontinuous Reception cycle that allows UE to extend paging cycles to save power.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE attaches to the network and can request power saving features.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE updates its tracking area and can request power saving features.

entities.name: Extended DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Information element containing extended DRX configuration parameters provided by the network to the UE.

entities.name: Active timer
entities.description: Timer that determines the active period during which UE can be paged before entering power saving state.

entities.name: Network decision on power saving features
entities.description: Condition where network decides whether to enable PSM, eDRX, both, or none based on UE request.

relations.description: UE can request PSM during attach procedure
UE can request eDRX during attach procedure
UE can request PSM during tracking area updating procedure
UE can request eDRX during tracking area updating procedure
Network decision guards whether PSM is enabled
Network decision guards whether eDRX is enabled
Extended DRX parameters IE configuration affects active timer behavior
When both PSM and eDRX are enabled, they interact to coordinate power saving
